name: Vietnam Solar PV Engineering Design — Climate adaptation, DC/AC ratio, tropical derating, QCVN 02:2022
standard: TCVN 11855-1:2017 / IEC 62446-1:2016 (PV system testing and documentation) + TCVN 6781:2017 / IEC 61215:2016 (Module design qualification) + TCVN 10884:2015 / IEC 61730:2011 (Safety qualification) + QCVN 02:2022/BXD (Vietnam Climate Data) + IEC 62548:2023 (PV array design)
description: Engineering validation for solar PV array design tailored to Vietnam's tropical monsoonal climate and regional weather zones. Validates optimal tilt angles (10° to 15° south-facing in Southern and Central Vietnam for self-cleaning during rainy seasons, 15° to 18° in Northern Vietnam). Verifies DC/AC overloading ratio (recommended 1.25 to 1.35 in Southern Vietnam and 1.30 to 1.40 in Northern Vietnam due to winter irradiation variations). Checks structural wind load survival per QCVN 02:2022/BXD (Zone I to IV wind pressure, typhoon resistance up to Beaufort scale 12-14 in coastal regions like Ninh Thuan, Binh Thuan, Quang Tri). Validates thermal loss coefficient derating for module operating temperatures exceeding 65°C under tropical solar irradiation (up to 1,800 - 2,000 kWh/m2/year in Southern Vietnam).
